title: AI meeting notes: turn any meeting into clear action items
seoTitle: AI meeting notes that turn into action items
description: Turn rough notes or a transcript into AI meeting notes: decisions, owners, dates and open questions. Includes prompts, a template and a checklist.
lede: AI meeting notes are only useful if they end in actions someone owns. This guide shows how to turn rough notes or a transcript into decisions, owners, dates and open questions, with two prompts, a summary template and checks to run before you send.
keywords: turn meeting notes into action items
